draft.subject: One small next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

I know a new tool can sit on the back burner during a busy week. The quickest way to see whether Wrenfield fits your team is to get one real project in: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Once that's there, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up. If email is easier, just tell me what you're working on and I'll point you to the right starting place.

Best,
Priya
